description: This file defines a repository interface for Role entities, leveraging Spring Data JPA. It provides methods for counting users associated with a role and retrieving roles by name.

classes.name: RoleRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Role entity operations, extends JPA repository interfaces for database interactions.

methods.name: getCountOfRolesAssociatedWithUsers
methods.description: Returns the number of users associated with a specific role that are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getRoleByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Role entity matching a given name, case-insensitive.
